description: Provisions the TLS certificate for SQL Server connection encryption end to end, on standalone instances and Failover Cluster Instances, and binds certificates to SSRS and Power BI Report Server HTTPS endpoints. Runs locally as a stdio MCP tool or from PowerShell. No command throws; every path returns a structured result. Windows only. Read-only tools are free; the rest are gated by an offline signed licence, so nothing about your estate leaves your network.
